en.name: Paella, leftover
en.summary: Leftover paella keeps 1 day in the refrigerator at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 1–2 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Cooked rice is the governing ingredient, and the rule for it is short and strict.
en.pantry: A paellera holds an enormous amount of heat, and a pan left on the table through a long lunch and then put away warm is the textbook way to get ill from rice. Uncooked rice carries Bacillus cereus spores that survive cooking, and the longer cooked rice sits at room temperature, the more likely it is that the bacteria or their toxins make it unsafe. Get the rice off the pan and spread it thin in shallow trays to cool as quickly as possible, ideally within one hour — never put the pan itself in the fridge.
en.fridge: 1 day at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, once it has been cooled fast. That is deliberately shorter than the general figure for cooked leftovers, and the reason is the rice rather than the seafood or the chicken. Keep it covered in a shallow container. Reheat once only, until it is steaming hot all the way through, and never reheat the same portion twice — a bowl warmed at lunch and warmed again at dinner is the pattern to avoid.
en.freezer: 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze it in single portions the same evening, once it has cooled fast — not the following day after a night in the fridge. Seafood paella suffers most, because prawns and mussels turn rubbery on reheating, so pick the shellfish out and freeze the rice on its own if you want the best result. Reheat from frozen, covered, with a splash of stock, until steaming.
en.thawing: Reheat straight from frozen, covered, with a splash of stock, until steaming hot throughout. If you thaw first, do it in the fridge and use it the same day. Never thaw on the counter.
spoilage: A sour or fermented smell when the cover comes off.
Rice that has gone slimy or clumped into a ropy mass.
An ammonia-like smell from the seafood.
Any mould, or a grey film over the surface.
tips: Spread the rice thin in shallow trays; never refrigerate the pan.
Cool it as quickly as possible, ideally within an hour of the meal.
Freeze portions the same evening rather than the next day.
Reheat once only, until steaming hot right through.

faq.q: How long does leftover paella keep?
faq.a: 1 day in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, provided it was cooled quickly. Cooked rice is what sets that limit.
Yes, 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze it the same evening in single portions, and reheat from frozen with a splash of stock.
No. Reheat only the portion you will eat, and only once, until steaming hot all the way through.

zh.name: 西班牙海鮮飯（剩菜）
zh.summary: 吃剩的 paella 冷藏 4 °C 以下可放 1 天，冷凍 −18 °C 下 1～2 個月。真正決定期限的是煮熟的米飯，而米飯的規則既短又嚴格。
zh.pantry: 一口 paellera 蓄熱驚人，而「整鍋在桌上撐過一頓長午餐、然後溫溫地收起來」，正是米飯讓人食物中毒的教科書寫法。生米帶有撐得過烹煮的仙人掌桿菌孢子，而熟飯在室溫下待得越久，細菌或其毒素讓這鍋飯變得不安全的機率就越高。請把飯從鍋裡取出、薄薄攤在淺盤上盡快降溫，最好在一小時內完成——絕對不要把整口鍋塞進冰箱。
zh.fridge: 在快速降溫的前提下，4 °C 以下 1 天。這比一般熟剩菜的數字刻意短，而原因在米飯，不在海鮮或雞肉。請用淺容器加蓋保存。回熱只能一次，而且要熱到整份冒蒸氣；同一份絕對不要熱兩次——中午熱過、晚上再熱一次，就是最該避免的模式。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 1～2 個月。請在當天晚上、快速降溫之後就分成單人份冷凍，而不是在冰箱放一晚之後隔天才處理。海鮮版本受損最大，因為蝦和淡菜回熱後會變得像橡皮，所以想要最好的結果，就把貝類挑出來、只冷凍米飯。回熱時直接從冷凍、加一點高湯、蓋著加熱到冒蒸氣。
zh.thawing: 直接從冷凍蓋著加熱，加一點高湯，熱到整份冒蒸氣。若要先解凍，請放冷藏並在當天吃完。不要放室溫退冰。
spoilage: 掀蓋就聞到酸味或發酵味。
米飯變得黏滑，或整團牽絲黏成一塊。
出現霉，或表面浮一層灰色薄膜。
tips: 把飯薄攤在淺盤降溫，絕對不要整鍋冰。
盡快降溫，最好在用餐結束後一小時內完成。
當天晚上就分份冷凍，不要拖到隔天。
只回熱一次，而且要熱到整份冒蒸氣。

faq.q: 吃剩的 paella 可以放多久？
faq.a: 在快速降溫的前提下，冷藏 4 °C 以下 1 天。決定這個上限的是熟米飯。
可以，−18 °C 下 1～2 個月。當天晚上分份冷凍，回熱時直接從冷凍加一點高湯加熱。
不行。要吃多少熱多少，只熱一次，而且要熱到整份冒蒸氣。
